title: DEC-173: The schedule executor cancels a claimed schedule whose entry left active (supersedes DEC-158(d) for that case) (2026-10-12)
text:
- **Problem**: independent review A-M7: BE03b:1898 says the executor cancels with entry_unavailable; DEC-158(d) said ScheduleExecutionResult omits cancelled because cancellation happens only in the invalidation transaction, leaving a race when a claim precedes the entry leaving active.
- **Options considered**: (A) executor cancels in its own transaction with a typed cancelled outcome; (B) keep blocking and rely on invalidation.
- **Decision**: (A). State guard allows executing -> cancelled only for entry_unavailable; the Worker sweep counts it as an attempt outcome, never as blocked.
- **Downstream**: migrations 20261010170000/170100, ScheduleExecutionResult contract, sweep telemetry, AC-083.
- **Reversibility**: Medium

title: DEC-174: Slice 11 relationship RLS predicates bind every role except the CMS definer (2026-10-12)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03b:2015-2016 require RLS predicates on verified session, acting party, relationship/assignment and capability, with positive/negative tests.
- **Options considered**: (A) relationship predicates on all roles including wejammin_cms_definer; (B) relationship predicates for every role except the definer, which stays tenant-scoped while definer RPC bodies enforce relationship scope.
- **Decision**: (B). A live mutant showed binding the definer breaks entry-archive and approval semantics and the 404/403 split; today the table ACL grants only postgres and the definer, so the predicates bind any future grantee and the session probe.
- **Downstream**: migration 20261010170200; any new grant on Slice 11 tables inherits the predicates.
- **Reversibility**: Medium

title: DEC-175: A pattern placement stores one composition row per root node of the pinned pattern (2026-10-12)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c does not define what a pattern placement stores when a pattern (a forest of 1-32 root blocks) is inserted into an entry composition (Slice 12 setup Q1).
- **Options considered**: (A) one row per root node pinned to (patternId, patternVersion) with its own block identity, the 201 returning an items list; (B) one row per insertion with nullable block identity; (C) one row per insertion using the first root.
- **Decision**: owner chose (A) on 2026-10-12. Keeps the Slice 11 checker input, the D5 block comparison hash (BE03b:1704) and the append-only composition table valid; follows the CMS-03C-15 items precedent. BE03c gains the rule that override keys are normalized node paths under the inserted root.
- **Downstream**: CMS-03C-02 success shape, composition instance list, Slice 12 criteria and tests.
- **Reversibility**: Medium

title: DEC-176: Patterns apply to entry revisions only; template-draft wording is reworded (2026-10-12)
text:
- **Problem**: IA03 AC-CMS-12 (IA03:46, :67) and BE03c:90 say "revision/template draft", but the contract (BE03c:365), the composition table (revision_id FK), the IA data model (DD03:230) and the render plan address entry revisions only; a template version holds slots and bindings, not a composition (Slice 12 setup Q2).
- **Options considered**: (A) entry revisions only, rewording IA03:46/:67, BE03c:90 and P2-S12-AC-026/AC-043; (B) specify a template-draft composition (new data model, hash, digest and render rule with no spec).
- **Decision**: owner chose (A) on 2026-10-12. B would be new feature design, not implementation of a locked spec.
- **Downstream**: IA03, BE03c, Slice 12 criteria AC-026 and AC-043 (applied with the Slice 12 DEC-148 cascade).
- **Reversibility**: Medium

title: DEC-177: P2-S11-AC-079 lists the executor cancelled (entry_unavailable) outcome (2026-10-12)
text:
- **Problem**: AC-079 enumerated ScheduleExecutionResult as completed, blocked, failed_retryable or already_completed; DEC-173 implemented BE03b:1898 and added cancelled with reason entry_unavailable.
- **Options considered**: (A) amend AC-079 to include cancelled; (B) revert DEC-173 so the executor blocks.
- **Decision**: owner chose (A) on 2026-10-12 ("A for AC-079"). Applied to the phase plan, Slice 11 tracker and evidence ledger.
- **Downstream**: a contract test must parse exactly the five outcomes before the clause is cited.
- **Reversibility**: Medium

title: PAT-028: Closure guards must follow the ledger, never demand a claim it does not support (2026-10-12)
text:
- **Type**: anti-pattern
- **Confidence**: 0.5
- **Context**: Slice-close guards that run inside `pnpm validate` (process-record attestation, tracker closeout).
- **Pattern**: A closeout guard drafted to require a Completion Signature would have forced either a false completion claim or a permanently red validate while P2-S11-AC-045 stays partial. Tie closure assertions to the evidence ledger both ways: the Depth Ratio line must name every non-verified criterion, the status must be `in-progress` and the signature absent while any criterion is open, and the signature is required once every criterion is verified. The canonical-validate attestation that a guard inside `pnpm validate` checks has a circular dependency (the run needs the line, the line records the run): write the line with the counts a prior full run produced, regenerate receipts, then let the canonical run itself verify the line; rewrite and rerun if any count differs. Never fill it from a non-canonical run and never leave the placeholder in a committed close.
- **Source**: Slice 11 closeout lane test (2026-10-12) required `- Completed:` unconditionally.

title: DEC-178: Slice 12 DEC-148 depth-floor cascade: floor 53 to 285, Phase 2 3314 authored / 3310 active (2026-10-12)
text:
- **Problem**: Slice 12 kept its pre-DEC-148 floor of 53 although BE03c defines CMS-03C-04 to CMS-03C-21 and five supporting reads, and IA flows CMS-15/CMS-16 and feature rows 25.05.03/25.05.04 belonged to no slice.
- **Options considered**: (A) apply DEC-148/DEC-149 per operation plus DEC-154 unowned obligations plus DEC-114 IA-level rows, keeping every judgement-call row; (B) the same without the judgement-call rows (five supporting reads, CMS-03C-04/-05 rows, six IA-level rows, six FE page rows).
- **Decision**: (A). New ids P2-S12-AC-054..AC-285 contiguous after AC-053: 135 per-operation (AC054-AC188), 91 cascade obligations (AC189-AC279), 6 IA-level (AC280-AC285). Slice 12 = 285 authored/active, 0 checked. Phase 2 = 3314 authored / 3310 active (AC209, AC211, AC265, AC266 stay outside the active denominator). The owner standing rule "more work now" decides every judgement-call row; derivation in .memory/pipeline/progress/verification/2026-10-11-slice-12-depth-floor.md.
- **Downstream**: phase-2.md Slice 12 section and coverage tables, Slice 12 tracker, progress index/phase/spec-pipeline totals, scripts/check-progress-consistency.mjs constants, the Slice 09 completion-policy and pre-traceability tests and their receipt rows, a Slice 12 evidence ledger over 285 rows.
- **Reversibility**: Medium

title: DEC-179: Slice 12 mechanical reconciliations R1-R4 of BE03c and FE03 (2026-10-12)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c and FE03 still carried text that DEC-172, DEC-158 and DEC-159 had corrected for Slice 11, and FE03 lists missed the 2026-10-07 cascade operations.
- **Options considered**: (A) propagate the existing rulings verbatim; (B) leave the drift for the Slice 12 implementation lanes to reconcile.
- **Decision**: (A). R1 response-contract failures are 502 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (DEC-172); R2 decision reason char_length 1-2000 and assignment/retire reasons 1-256 NFC code points (DEC-158); R3 metric label subject_kind (DEC-159); R4 FE03 protected read lists include cmsPatternLatestRead, cmsTaxonomyVersionsRead and cmsTaxonomyTermsRead, the step-up command list includes CMS-03C-07/-08/-09, and the data-mapping row names CMS-03C-01..21.
- **Downstream**: BE03c, FE03, Slice 12 rows that cite those lines.
- **Reversibility**: High

title: DEC-180: Slice 12 implementation decisions G2-G4, G6, G8, G9, G11 and R5 readings (owner may override) (2026-10-12)
text:
- **Problem**: BE03c left implementation choices open and stated four statuses two ways (setup report sections 5 and 6).
- **Options considered**: per item, the setup report recommendation versus leaving the item for the implementing lane.
- **Decision**: G2 BE03c gains a lock-order paragraph placing every Slice 12 writer in the BE03b global order (extends DEC-157; BE03c no longer prescribes the order DEC-157 rejected); G3 activation and retirement events use the subject version row as outbox aggregate and term actions the term row; G4 CMS-03C-14 with no newer compatible version answers 200 with paths [], collisionCount 0, bulkEligible false, targetPatternVersion = pinnedPatternVersion; G6 cms_invalidate_governed_reviews_for_person mirrors BE03b:1872 and rule 7 of the BE03b lock order; G8 the exact impact set is compatibleTypeIds plus the block tuples behind blockRegistryDigest, and the undefined "approved impact-read scope" becomes the governed-review read scope; G9 cms.governed_review.recheck and cms.pattern.linked_update_scan are typed platform-queue messages (DEC-166), cms.taxonomy.merge_converge a BE00 jobs row; G11 submitting a taxonomy version with an unbuilt canonical domain is 422 canonical_source_unavailable with details.domain. R5: nested_pattern_not_active and pattern_version_not_active are 422 (request validation; 409 stays for stale CAS operands); every governed 409 is GOVERNED_REVIEW_VERSION_CONFLICT with the reason in details.reasonCode; the digest is an equality expectation the server recomputes and refuses on mismatch. Lane-derived drafts (non-node overrides key 422 at /overrides; PatternPlacementResource; G2 position 6 for cms_terms) stand until review. G5 is not applied: rewording BE03b:251/:1538 changes Slice 10 AC030 and goes to the owner wording batch.
- **Downstream**: BE03c, FE03, IA03 consequences, Slice 12 rows AC065, AC068, AC073, AC085, AC114, AC201, AC202, AC204, AC212, AC226, AC248-AC250, AC261, AC262, AC276.
- **Reversibility**: High
